title: Number of Prefix Connected Groups
summary: Given an array of strings and an integer k, count the number of groups of at least two words where each pair of words shares the same prefix of length k.
statement: Given an array of strings and an integer k, count the number of groups of at least two words where each pair of words shares the same prefix of length k. Exclude words shorter than k and consider duplicates as separate words.
constraints: words may contain duplicates, which count as separate entries; k is positive.
A group is a length-k prefix shared by at least two eligible words; return the number of such prefixes.
hints: Only the first k characters determine membership.
Count eligible words by their length-k prefix.
Ignore short words, then count frequency buckets of at least two.
Each eligible word belongs to exactly one prefix group, and duplicate entries increment its frequency independently.
editorial: Each eligible word belongs to exactly one prefix group, and duplicate entries increment its frequency independently.

tests.explanation: Prefixes ap and ba each occur twice, producing two groups.
Only abc and abd are long enough, but their length-three prefixes differ, so return zero.
